Burst playbook

  1. Stop: low of the entry day. Exit the same day if the gain fades below entry.
  2. Breakeven: once up 4-5%, move the stop to breakeven.
  3. No follow-through by day 3: exit.
  4. Up 8%+: sell about half, trail the stop under each day's high.
  5. Sell into strength. Time-exit most positions on days 3-5. Target band 8-40%.

Crossover notes

  1. This is a trend entry held for weeks. The burst playbook does not apply here.
  2. Common management: stop under the most recent swing low or the slow EMA, review weekly.
  3. Crossovers in a stock already up a lot are late; the 20-bar ret column helps you judge.
  4. Data is end of day, so the timeframes are Daily and Weekly. A 4-hour view needs intraday data, which the free NSE archive does not publish.

How the score works

  1. Daily gap is EMA 20 vs EMA 100 on the daily chart. Negative means EMA 20 is still below; the smaller the gap, the more points (up to 45).
  2. Closing speed is how fast that gap has narrowed over the last 5 sessions. A pace that crosses within ~3 days scores the full 35 points, fading to 0 at 15 days. A widening gap scores 0 here.
  3. Price above the daily EMA 100 adds 10 points, above the EMA 20 another 10.
  4. A stock that has already crossed on daily scores 100 · Confirmed. Score 70+ is a strong candidate, below 40 the 4h signal is early.
  5. Scoring always uses daily EMA 20/100 to match your Chartink strategy, whatever the EMA tab is set to. Stocks marked no data are outside the page's coverage (below the ₹3 cr turnover floor, or a non-EQ series).
